subject.title: [Bug]: Feishu text commands (/stop, /new, /status) no longer bypass queue during active agent run (3.8 regression)

question: Should authorized Feishu whole-message text slash commands beyond abort triggers, especially `/status` and `/new`, bypass the per-chat sequential queue during active runs and be marked as structured `text-slash` command turns?
rationale: The source gap is clear, but the permanent fix changes the boundary between Feishu sender admission, command authorization, immediate control handling, and session-state mutation during active runs.

options.title: Adopt Feishu-scoped text-command contract
options.body: Mark authorized Feishu whole-message commands as structured text-slash turns and bypass the ordinary lane only for commands maintainers classify as immediate controls, with explicit `/new` policy and tests.

options.title: Keep abort-only bypass
options.body: Leave `/status` and `/new` on the ordinary Feishu lane and document that only abort text bypasses active per-chat queueing.

options.title: Move policy into shared channel helpers
options.body: Generalize text-command turn construction and authorization for all plugin channels, accepting broader compatibility and security review.

recommendation.title: Adopt Feishu-scoped text-command contract
recommendation.body: Mark authorized Feishu whole-message commands as structured text-slash turns and bypass the ordinary lane only for commands maintainers classify as immediate controls, with explicit `/new` policy and tests.

likelyOwner.reason: The open decision is primarily about shared command authorization and command-turn policy, where the strongest history signal points to steipete.
